notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Purphoros.
Purphoros does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least five devotion to red.
description:
Cast Tainted Strike, giving Purphoros +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Purphoros by tapping it, creating a number of Elemental tokens with haste equal to Purphoros's power.
The tokens enter, triggering Purphoros seven times.
Resolve each trigger giving each opponent fourteen poison counters.
